facts.business: Trigyn Technologies Limited provides IT services and solutions including e-governance projects, staffing, and infrastructure management.

auditor.name: V Rohatgi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) RBI approvals for wound-up overseas subsidiaries (Note 48); 2) Non-accounting of Quarterly Guaranteed Revenue of Rs 8,000 lakhs (Note 52A); 3) Toll Collection project in Nashik with unamortized capital cost of Rs 352 lakhs and arbitration (Note 52B, 34g); 4) Pending legal suits (Note 34); 5) Foreign subsidiary under voluntary liquidation (Note 64); 6) Advances to United Telecoms Limited and Priyaraja Electronics Limited converted to inter-corporate loans with interest income recognized but formal agreements pending (Note 41).

key_risks: Delay in completion of APSFL fixed price contract project
Non-collection of guaranteed revenue of Rs 8,000 lakhs
Toll collection project termination and arbitration in Nashik
Pending legal suits filed by and against the company and its subsidiary
Inter-corporate loans to related parties with pending formal documentation
facts.related_party_note: Advances extended to United Telecoms Limited and Priyaraja Electronics Limited pursuant to MOU, subsequently converted to inter-corporate loans under Section 185. Interest income of Rs 84 lakhs recognized in FY2026 (cumulative Rs 210 lakhs). Formal loan agreements and balance confirmations pending as at March 31, 2026.
